review: Caelestis corpus obsolescence, contradiction and standards sanity audit

findings.title: Draft and non-enforceable instruments are published through an index described as active
findings.repair: Expose lifecycle metadata in generated indexes; segregate or exclude Draft and Proposed instruments; add validator coverage.

findings.title: PLATINUM filenames contradict Draft and Not Enforceable lifecycle metadata
findings.repair: Reserve PLATINUM for Adopted or Active instruments, or formally decouple the label while making lifecycle status unavoidable.

findings.title: Retired dyadic, triadic and polyadic terminology remains current doctrine
findings.repair: Replace with explicit participant, organisational mediation, coordination, distribution and jurisdiction descriptors; preserve historical interpretation outside current normative vocabulary.

findings.title: Annex K exceeds its declared source-authority boundary
findings.repair: Move substantive legitimacy, credential, target and containment doctrine to SECURITY; move procedure to OPERATIONS; keep Annex K to runtime-facing interfaces and signals.

findings.title: Runtime formation and configuration evidence is optional where conformance requires it
findings.repair: Define mandatory minimum runtime-formation records for conformance, material changes, incidents, agentic actions, evaluations and pathway transitions.

findings.title: No interoperable AI-BOM implementation exists
findings.repair: Map a minimum Caelestis profile to SPDX 3.x and/or CycloneDX; add identifiers, relationships, versioning, provenance, deployment snapshots, governance bindings, fixtures and validators.

findings.title: Agentic governance lacks a consolidated accountable-actor lifecycle model
findings.repair: Create a source-authoritative agentic deployment and accountability profile composing existing domains without duplicating them.

findings.title: Authority Role is uncontrolled prose
findings.repair: Define a controlled Authority Role vocabulary, default ordinary instruments to None, and represent source authority through structured lineage fields.

findings.title: Speculative consciousness and welfare research is embedded in the canonical governance tree
findings.repair: Move to a clearly non-normative proposals or research area, or exclude entirely from operative indexes and registries until adopted.

findings.title: Speculative macroeconomic policy appendices contaminate the AI governance corpus
findings.repair: Remove speculative policy drafts from the current normative tree and retain only AI-specific economic governance with a defensible corpus relationship.

findings.title: Internal CAM Standard labels are not evidence of external conformity
findings.repair: State that CAM tiers are internal; prohibit unsupported ISO, NIST, EU or certification claims; define implementation evidence requirements for future CAM conformance claims.

findings.title: The corpus is over-instrumented and source authority is difficult to determine
findings.repair: Produce a concept-to-source-authority map and replace duplicate normative definitions with exact cross-references.

external_sanity_sources: Singapore IMDA Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI v1.5
limitations: No clause-level ISO conformity claim was made because full licensed ISO text was not available for direct review.
This register records initial material findings and will expand during source-authority and instrument-by-instrument review.
